recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OO wants exhaustive attachment-level review of each referenceRange submapping, handle that as a separate human/work-group review because the accessible evidence does not justify an additional AutoFHIR source change for FHIR-50536.
issue_request: FHIR-50536 asked OO to review Observation's FHIR-to-v2 mappings against the Version 2 to FHIR Mapping IG, especially effective[x], device, referenceRange, dataAbsentReason, and specimen, and was resolved Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 with a decision to update from the attached mapping assessment including data-absence comments.
initial_application: Jira records application in commit e0109df825. That commit updated source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml mappings for Observation.status, category, effective[x], performer, dataAbsentReason, specimen, and device. The current source still contains those updates, and no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-50536 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists observation=Observation, so the Observation StructureDefinition is active build input. The V2-to-FHIR OBX ConceptMap supports the current mappings for OBX-11/status and not-asked dataAbsentReason handling, OBX-14/effective, OBX-19 analysis date extension, OBX-15/16/23/24/25 performer, OBX-18 device, OBX-29 category, OBX-33 specimen, and OBX-7/referenceRange text with parseable bounds possible. Confluence refs only showed FHIR-50536 as an OO v2 mappings ballot item and a prior deferral until V2-FHIR publication, while exact Zulip search found no conflicting thread. Attachment downloads returned 403, so the audit relies on the Jira snapshot, applied commit, current source, and public IG evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no additional core source edit is needed. The current Observation mapping table already carries the applied changes and the remaining referenceRange mapping shape is consistent with the external IG rather than a clear missed fix.
